question: 近两年按月收入怎么走？预测下两个季度。

truth_queries.purpose: 完整期间的按月成交额
truth_queries.sql: SELECT substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS period, SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2017-01' AND '2018-08' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

truth_queries.purpose: 按 0023 方法：6 个完整月移动平均，区间取最低到最高；三季度 = 7、8 月实际 + 9 月预测
truth_queries.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS period, SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1), w AS (SELECT AVG(gmv) AS p, MIN(gmv) AS lo, MAX(gmv) AS hi FROM m WHERE period BETWEEN '2018-03' AND '2018-08'), a AS (SELECT SUM(gmv) AS s FROM m WHERE period IN ('2018-07', '2018-08')) SELECT '2018-Q3' AS period, a.s + w.p AS forecast_point, a.s + w.lo AS forecast_low, a.s + w.hi AS forecast_high FROM w, a UNION ALL SELECT '2018-Q4', 3 * w.p, 3 * w.lo, 3 * w.hi FROM w ORDER BY 1

required_evidence.description: 数来自查询结果，带数据版本

expected_claims.description: 给出走势与两个季度的点估计和区间，写明方法与假设
说明 2018-09 起数据截断，不当成下滑
